tracks.mood: tender, nostalgic, shy-proud married devotion with a grin
tracks.subject: A Chiayi taxi driver phones the noon Taigi request show from the station rank every day with a dedication list so long the host always cuts him off before the last name, his wife's, until the day he reads it backwards.

tracks.title: 逐家攑豬 Ta̍k-ke Gia̍h Ti
tracks.subject: A young Irish priest posted to a Taigi-speaking parish in rural Changhua keeps getting his tones wrong, asking the lunch table to pick up their pigs (豬) instead of chopsticks (箸), until the front-pew old ladies adopt his slips as parish slang.

tracks.title: 穿較燒咧 Tshīng Khah Sio--leh
tracks.subject: A young home-care nurse from Taipei whose only Taigi is what her mother shouted at her as a child (eat up, hurry, put a jacket on) finds on her Pingtung scooter rounds that it is exactly what her old patients want to hear.

tracks.title: 彼台電視無歹去 Hit Tâi Tiān-sī Bô Phái--khì
tracks.mood: wry, hazy, a small tender ache in a quiet afternoon shop
tracks.subject: A Tainan TV-repair shopkeeper realises the old woman who carries in the same working CRT television every Thursday, swearing the picture is snowy, only wants a chair and her one channel of Taigi opera, so he pretends to tune it, and the week she skips he shoulders a set to her door.

tracks.title: หมูย่างตะแกรงพัดลม
tracks.subject: Payday Friday at Ton's rented Lat Phrao townhouse: two kilos of marinated pork neck, a glowing charcoal stove and no grill rack, so he unscrews the front guard of their only standing fan and grills on it, leaving fan-striped pork and a bare fan.

tracks.title: เคี้ยวไปก่อน
tracks.subject: A Bangkok taxi driver, forty days after quitting cigarettes, chews mint gum at every red light while his wife folds each wrapper into a paper chain along their bedroom wall; tonight he learns half the wrappers are hers, chewed to keep him company.

tracks.title: ผัวฉันชื่อบักสีดา
tracks.subject: A Swedish son-in-law in an Udon Thani village, whose name Björn nobody can pronounce, is renamed Bak Sida (Isan for guava, hence farang) by his mother-in-law on day one; three years on he answers to nothing else and calls his wife Bak Hung, papaya.

tracks.title: เสื่อผืนเดิม
tracks.subject: A Bangkok couple have spread the same free plastic mat, printed with a tyre shop's name, อารักษ์การยาง, under one rain tree at Suan Rot Fai for eleven years; the print has rubbed away until only the รัก (love) inside อารักษ์ is left.

tracks.title: ทิลท์อีกแล้ว
tracks.subject: A Bangkok man called Pop shoves a pinball machine so hard at a Sam Yan arcade that it flashes TILT on every ball; the owner, Auntie Lek, tapes a sign on it, and the night he finally plays gently he wins a free game and has no idea what to do.

tracks.title: Một Cây Bút, Một Chữ Ký
tracks.subject: Chị Thoa has guarded the steel stationery cabinet on the third floor of a Quy Nhơn trading company for twenty years like a general holding a mountain pass: one ballpoint each, only against the dead one and a signature, director included; the morning her own pen dies mid-form she has to borrow one from the junior clerk she turned away an hour earlier, and he makes her sign for it.

tracks.title: Phấn Xanh Trên Tay Áo
tracks.genre: Vietnamese honky-tonk country shuffle (nhạc đồng quê)
tracks.subject: A husband swears he was working late, but the blue cue chalk on his shirt cuff says bi-a hall, so the next evening his wife walks in, borrows a cue and clears the table, and Thursdays become their night out.

tracks.title: Cứ Đi Chậm Thôi
tracks.genre: Vietnamese thính phòng (bán cổ điển) art-song crossover
tracks.subject: New to Saigon from a canal hamlet in Bến Tre, a woman froze each evening at the kerb of Điện Biên Phủ street until a colleague offered his arm and walked her through the motorbikes, slowly, never stopping, never running; a year on, one ordinary weekend, he is her boyfriend, frozen at the coconut-trunk monkey bridge before her childhood home, and she leads him across by the hand.

tracks.title: Giọng Thuyết Minh Sau Lưng
tracks.genre: Nhạc tiền chiến salon ballad revival (1940s Hanoi tân nhạc)
tracks.subject: A xe ôm driver realises the old woman giving directions over his shoulder is the single voice that narrated every foreign film of his childhood, and at her gate asks her to say 'the end' once more, as she did after every film.

tracks.title: Cô Hạnh Nghỉ Một Tuần
tracks.subject: When the only pharmacist who can read old Dr. Tám's handwriting takes a week off, nobody in the ward can fill a prescription, and the doctor has to print in block capitals like a first-grader until she comes back.

tracks.title: 一炮三響
tracks.subject: At four siblings' monthly mahjong night round Big Sister's Sha Tin dining table, played for who buys the milk tea, she takes five minutes over every discard while the others doze, until she finally throws a five-dot and all three win on it at once.

tracks.title: 求其填
tracks.subject: A 48-year-old clerk in a Sheung Wan shipping office fills in the morning paper's Sudoku in ball-pen before the pantry kettle boils, and the whole floor thinks he is a genius, though he just writes any numbers because nobody ever checks; when the tea lady spots three sevens in one row he confesses to everyone, and nobody believes him: so clever, they say, and modest too.

tracks.title: 你嗰半有我
tracks.subject: Before her boyfriend leaves for a two-year posting in Toronto, a woman breaks their finished 1,000-piece world-map jigsaw down the middle; he takes the half with Hong Kong, she keeps the half with Toronto, and he carries his home rebuilt in a pizza box.

tracks.title: 搖搖板
tracks.mood: flirty, teasing, rocking sway, playful payback
tracks.subject: Two childhood playmates meet at thirty-five by their Wong Tai Sin estate seesaw: at seven she was the heavy one who kept him dangling until he said please; now he outweighs her, she hangs in the air, and his 'please' is asking her to dinner.

tracks.title: 阿爺玩滑梯
tracks.subject: A 71-year-old raised in a hillside squatter hut with no playground rides the long slide in Tuen Mun Park for the first time because his four-year-old granddaughter won't go alone, then climbs back up by himself while she waits below to catch him.

tracks.title: 陳怡君請上車
tracks.subject: Number 17 of forty-three women all named 陳怡君 on their namesake club's coach trip, where roll call is one name answered forty-three times; when a rest-area loudspeaker pages the late one, three strangers with that name come running too.

tracks.title: 老樣子
tracks.subject: A woman who studies her hand-shaken tea shop's sixty-item menu board for five minutes every evening while the queue sighs, then orders the same light-sugar, no-ice Four Seasons oolong as always, until the clerk laminates a one-item menu just for her.

tracks.title: 我姓范姜
tracks.subject: A Taoyuan man with the rare double surname 范姜 has been called 'Mr. Fan' all his life by teachers, waiters and couriers, until the one courier who reads his parcel label right turns out to be a 張簡, forever 'Mr. Zhang'.

tracks.title: 你坐我右邊
tracks.subject: A left-handed woman and right-handed boyfriend whose elbows knocked all through their first date at a seven-stool ramen counter; now she always sits on his left so they can eat and hold hands, and when only the wrong seats are free, both eat wrong-handed.

tracks.title: 站上牛奶箱
tracks.mood: tender, warm, quietly proud, gently buoyant
tracks.subject: Best friends since first grade, one 191 cm and always back-row centre, one 158 cm and always front-row centre in every class photo, open a café together; for the opening-day picture the short one stands on a milk crate so their heads are level.

tracks.title: Panel B, Panel B, Panel B
tracks.subject: a man in a Swindon back garden assembling a flat-pack shed on a Saturday and finding the kit has three wall panels stamped B and none stamped C, so he builds it anyway with the window facing the fence

tracks.title: Lemon and Basil
tracks.subject: a woman whose homemade lemon-and-basil candle side hustle takes over her one-bed flat, wax on the hob and boxes on the bed, until the postman says the whole street smells of her and she has sold just four

tracks.title: The Knee That Clicks
tracks.subject: a wife who says she can find her husband in a dark house by the click of his left knee on every step, and he takes her out dancing on their anniversary so she can hear it keep time

tracks.title: Same Heel Again
tracks.subject: a woman who runs a one-person shoe repair kiosk in Lewisham and realises the man who brings in the same brown brogue with a worn heel every second week has been walking it down on purpose

tracks.title: Day Three of the Hiccups
tracks.subject: a man in Croydon who has had the hiccups for three days, working through every cure his coworkers swear by, sugar, a paper bag, drinking upside down, a sudden shout from behind, and none of them working

tracks.title: Pompa Air Si Mbah
tracks.subject: a man in a Bekasi kontrakan whose second-hand water pump dies every morning right when he is soaped up in the shower, so he runs out in a towel to prime it with a bucket, talks to it like an old grandfather, and his wife times him from the kitchen

tracks.title: Genteng Ketiga dari Kiri
tracks.subject: a young married couple in Cimahi on a Sunday afternoon swapping cracked roof tiles on their kontrakan, she passes the new genteng up the ladder one by one while he, scared of heights, will only keep climbing if she keeps talking to him

tracks.title: Daun di Jok Motor
tracks.subject: an accountant in Jakarta whose odd private hobby is tracing the outline of whichever leaf has landed on his motorbike seat each morning into a notebook, dated, four hundred pages so far, until one morning there is a leaf from a tree that does not grow on his street

tracks.title: Biskuit di Canang
tracks.subject: a young woman in Denpasar whose morning round of placing canang offerings in front of the family shop is followed every day by a skinny brown stray dog who eats the biscuit off each offering, until she starts quietly putting one extra biscuit just for him and names him Kopi

tracks.title: Nona di Atas Toren
tracks.genre: Ambonese pop ballad with steel guitar
tracks.subject: a young woman in Ambon moving into her first kontrakan who finds the house comes with a grey stray cat sleeping on the water tank and a note from the last tenant saying her name is Nona and she likes smoked fish, and slowly the cat becomes hers

tracks.title: カレーは平等に
tracks.subject: a fifth-grader on school-lunch serving duty who must ladle the curry evenly into thirty-two bowls, knowing the last scraped bowl is hers

tracks.title: 目地が乾くまで
tracks.subject: a couple re-sealing the mouldy silicone around the bathtub of their small apartment on a Sunday, then spending the 24 hours they cannot bathe sitting on the kitchen floor together

tracks.title: ベルマーク・ナイト
tracks.subject: a father who drew the PTA Bell Mark role, staying up at the dining table cutting tiny coupons off mayonnaise and pencil packets and sorting them onto collection sheets

tracks.title: カルピスは帰ってくる
tracks.subject: an office worker who re-gifts the Calpis gift box she receives every summer, only for the same box, with her own sticky note still inside, to come back to her three summers in a row

tracks.title: 名前を呼ぶ練習
tracks.subject: a new teacher the night before her first entrance ceremony, practising reading her thirty-four first-graders' names aloud, stuck on the hard-to-read kanji ones

tracks.title: 어깨 펴
tracks.subject: a woman whose boyfriend silently taps her shoulder blade with two fingers every time she slouches over her laptop in their usual café, and she starts slouching on purpose

tracks.title: 회원님 어디세요
tracks.subject: a woman who paid for a twelve-month gym membership in January, went twice, and now gets weekly personal texts from the gym owner asking where she is

tracks.title: 무인 가게 사장님
tracks.subject: the owner of a staffless ice-cream shop who watches the CCTV every night and finds one primary-school boy who pays in exact coins and leaves a sticky-note review each time

tracks.title: 열다섯의 편지
tracks.subject: a 35-year-old receiving the letter her fifteen-year-old self wrote for a school time capsule, which orders her to be married to a boy-band member and own a red convertible by now

tracks.title: 열한 시에 잘 거야
tracks.subject: a 30-year-old office worker who declares going to bed at exactly eleven p.m. her act of rebellion against her team's all-nighter culture and lays out pyjamas at ten-thirty like armour

tracks.title: Esok Datang, Bang Lah
tracks.genre: Malay kampung polka (accordion-and-tuba oom-pah comedy song)
tracks.subject: a kampung family whose rotten serambi floorboard has been propped on a paint tin for six weeks because the village handyman Bang Lah answers every call with 'esok'

tracks.title: Hutang Lima Puluh
tracks.subject: a guy whose best friend has owed him fifty ringgit for two years and keeps paying it off one teh tarik at a time at the mamak, adding up the tab out loud

tracks.title: Nasi Goreng Pukul Sebelas
tracks.subject: a man who wakes his wife at eleven at night because he has made nasi goreng kampung with too much cili padi for no reason at all, and they eat it on the kitchen floor

tracks.title: Zink Atas Kepala
tracks.subject: two old friends replacing the rusted zinc roof sheets of a kampung house on one Saturday, one on the roof counting screws, the other on the ladder passing sheets up

tracks.title: Bubur Untuk Seorang
tracks.genre: Malay 1950s exotica lounge (vibraphone-and-flute space-age bachelor-pad pop)
tracks.subject: a woman living alone who suddenly boils a full periuk of bubur kacang hijau on a Tuesday afternoon for no occasion and spends the week eating it at every meal

tracks.title: 孔蓋的花 Khang-kuà ê Hue
tracks.subject: a woman who spends every Sunday dawn kneeling in the road making crayon rubbings of Taiwan's decorated city manhole covers onto cloth, while her boyfriend, who first laughed at the hobby, now stands guard against scooters and hunts for new covers himself

tracks.title: 招牌寫毋著 Tsiau-pâi Siá M̄-tio̍h
tracks.subject: a brother and sister at their family signboard shop in Chiayi who discover, the night before a noodle shop opens, that the two-storey sign they just hung has an extra digit in the phone number, and climb back up at midnight to repaint it while a police patrol shines a torch on them

tracks.title: 退倒轉來的批 Thè Tò-tńg--lâi ê Phue
tracks.subject: a husband married twenty-five years who finds in a shoebox the postcard he mailed her from army training in 1999, returned for a wrong house number, and hand-delivers it across the kitchen table; she reads it aloud and writes her reply on a fridge note

tracks.title: 壁癌 Piah-gâm
tracks.subject: a young tenant in an old Kaohsiung walk-up who scrapes the white efflorescence (wall cancer) off his rented room's damp wall every spring, layers on waterproof paint and filler, and watches it bloom back beside the patch, refusing to give up on one clean white wall

tracks.title: 秤仔店 Tshìn-á Tiàm
tracks.subject: a single woman of forty-five running her family's scale-repair shop on Changhua's old street, calibrating brass steelyards and shop scales, who winks at a vendor whose scale reads three qian heavy and refuses to close though everyone now buys cheap electronic scales

tracks.title: ผัวขึ้นบันได
tracks.genre: Central Thai luk thung stage-revue (wong luk thung with brass)
tracks.subject: a wife standing hands-on-hips at the foot of a ladder directing her husband, step by step, as he tries to fix the sagging kitchen gutter with silicone that ends up on him instead of the gutter

tracks.title: ห่อปกเล่มละห้าบาท
tracks.genre: Bangkok hot swing small-combo song (Lindy-hop revival)
tracks.subject: a schoolboy who sets up his old desk at the school gate on the first day of term charging five baht a book to cover textbooks in clear plastic, until the strict discipline teacher walks over and puts down three of her own notebooks

tracks.title: แมวส้มข้ามระเบียง
tracks.genre: Thai mahori-ensemble classical song (phleng Thai doem)
tracks.subject: a man whose neighbour's orange cat crosses onto his balcony every night, so each night he carries it back to her door, until the night the cat does not come and she knocks on his door herself

tracks.title: ไฮไลต์ทั้งเล่ม
tracks.subject: a student the night before a biology exam who highlights every single line of a friend's photocopied notes until three yellow pens run dry, falls asleep, and wakes with a page stuck to her cheek

tracks.title: นับหัวก่อนออกรถ
tracks.genre: Thai Gen-Z campus band pop-rock (Gene Lab style, upbeat)
tracks.subject: a student on a class trip to Kanchanaburi who is paired by roll number with number 24, the boy who never talks, and by the River Kwai bridge they are friends; on the way back the teacher counts thirty-nine and he runs back holding two ice creams

tracks.title: Hốt Hụi Đầu
tracks.subject: a young man who bids a ruinous interest rate to take the first pot of a hụi run by five old high-school classmates so he can buy a second-hand Vespa to take a girl out, then spends the next eleven months paying in on instant noodles while the classmates read out his bid at every meeting

tracks.title: Hộp Sữa Sau Khi Hiến Máu
tracks.subject: a couple whose anniversary ritual is donating blood together every three months at the Hanoi Red Cross blood centre, where he always goes pale and dizzy afterwards and she sits holding the free milk carton and biscuits for him, joking that her blood keeps him going

tracks.title: Huýt Sáo
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old man in Đà Nẵng who has never been able to whistle, secretly practising on the balcony every evening with pursed lips and only air coming out, while his girlfriend inside pretends not to hear, until the night one thin wobbly note finally comes out and she whistles back

tracks.title: Chuồng Cọp Tầng Bốn
tracks.subject: a retired tram driver who welds an iron-cage chuồng cọp extension onto his fourth-floor flat in an old Thành Công collective block so his wife can grow chillies and mint in polystyrene boxes, and keeps quietly repainting it green each time the ward inspector comes to measure it

tracks.title: Hội Vỗ Tay Năm Giờ Sáng
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old office worker who throws his back out lifting a watermelon and, on doctor's orders to move, ends up the only young member of the grandmothers' five a.m. clapping-exercise group by Hoàn Kiếm Lake, who adopt him, correct his posture and send him home with boiled peanuts

tracks.title: 摺牆床
tracks.subject: a man in a 160-square-foot Tai Kok Tsui flat whose fold-down wall bed has a stuck spring, so every night at midnight he has to wrestle it down like a dance partner, and every morning it springs back up and traps his work shirt

tracks.title: 三十支豉油
tracks.subject: a woman who buys thirty bottles of soy sauce on a supermarket half-price day and then has nowhere in her tiny flat to put them, so they end up under the bed, in the shoe cabinet and lined along the bathtub

tracks.title: 見光就乞嚏
tracks.subject: a woman in a windowless Sham Shui Po subdivided flat who sneezes three times every morning the moment she steps out of the dark stairwell into sunlight, while the herbal-tea shop owner downstairs counts them, and three rainy days without a sneeze leave her feeling she has not woken up

tracks.title: 凌晨四點十七
tracks.subject: a woman who is woken at exactly 4:17 every night by a calf cramp and has to stand barefoot on the cold kitchen tiles of her tiny flat, flexing her toes and counting the trucks on the flyover until the knot lets go

tracks.title: 十二圈
tracks.subject: a woman who buys her boyfriend a loud brass twin-bell wind-up alarm clock from a Sham Shui Po second-hand shop because he never wakes on time, and every night before she goes home she winds it exactly twelve turns at his bedside, until one night he winds it for her

tracks.title: 冷凍庫裝不下
tracks.subject: a woman who meal-preps twenty-one lunch boxes every Sunday night and plays Tetris to fit them into the tiny freezer of her shared flat, evicting her flatmate's ice cream tub one box at a time

tracks.title: 一刀不斷
tracks.subject: an office worker whose secret hobby is peeling an apple in one unbroken strip, practising every night on supermarket apples to beat his own record of two point three metres while his girlfriend is made to eat every apple

tracks.title: 記帳本
tracks.subject: a couple who share one paper spending notebook on the kitchen table, where she writes small remarks beside his entries like 'braised snacks 85, didn't share', until he realises the ledger has become their diary

tracks.title: 櫥窗第三格
tracks.subject: a young woman who walks past a shoe shop every evening to look at one pair of red leather heels in the third window slot priced 4,280, saving 150 dollars a day in a tin and counting how many days are left before someone else buys them

tracks.title: 咖哩第七天
tracks.genre: Mandarin New Orleans second-line brass pop
tracks.subject: a man who misreads grams in a curry recipe, cooks a five-kilo pot, and has to eat it for seven days, reinventing it each night as curry udon, curry toast, curry fried rice and curry hotpot

tracks.title: One Hosepipe Between Us
tracks.subject: a man on an allotment who shares one hosepipe through the fence with the woman on the next plot, and starts leaving tomatoes on her shed step every Sunday until she leaves a note asking him to dinner

tracks.title: Four Kettles Make a Bath
tracks.subject: four flatmates whose boiler dies the week before the landlord's man can come, running every kettle and pan in the house in relay to fill one bath and drawing lots for who gets in first

tracks.title: Tagged at Four Pounds Fifty
tracks.subject: a Saturday volunteer at a charity shop who prices a gold sequin jacket from the donation bags at four pounds fifty, then buys it herself and wears it on the till before the shop opens

tracks.title: Your Sofa, Week Three
tracks.subject: a man sleeping on his friend's sofa for a third week after a flat fell through, folding the duvet into a perfect square by seven every morning and learning to dodge the friend's cat at the fridge

tracks.title: Five Minutes Flat
tracks.subject: a woman training on her living-room rug to hold a plank for five full minutes before her fiftieth birthday, counting on the oven clock while her husband reads the seconds out loud

tracks.title: Bintang Lima Buat Istri
tracks.subject: a Depok ojek driver who spends his one Sunday off taking his wife out on the same motorbike, giving her the full app-style service (spare helmet, mask, 'sesuai titik ya, Bu?') and at the end giving her five stars out loud

tracks.title: Buku Bon Warung Bu Tini
tracks.genre: Indonesian balada folk with harmonica (Iwan Fals-style)
tracks.subject: the owner of a warung kopi near a Jakarta campus who keeps a dog-eared bon book of students' unpaid kopi and Indomie, reading out their debts every month, then tearing out one page as a gift when a debtor brings his graduation photo

tracks.title: Galon Siapa?
tracks.subject: six tenants of a kost in Jatinangor holding a midnight 'trial' in the hallway over who drank the last glass from the water galon and did not buy a new one, until they find the landlady's cat drinking from the drip tray

tracks.title: Kereta Ekonomi ke Kutoarjo
tracks.subject: a Jakarta man on the economy train to Kutoarjo for Lebaran, going home with his girlfriend for the first time, practising polite Javanese greetings for her family while she corrects his pronunciation and laughs

tracks.title: Batik Kembar Hari Jumat
tracks.genre: keroncong-dangdut fusion with Middle Eastern groove
tracks.subject: an office clerk in Solo who buys a new batik shirt for Batik Friday at a small shop on Jalan Slamet Riyadi, only to discover the shop owner sold the exact same motif to his boss, so every Friday they turn up as twins and the whole floor wants a photo

tracks.title: いらっしゃいませ選手権
tracks.subject: a quiet convenience-store part-timer whose manager says her 'irasshaimase' is too small, who secretly practises it in the walk-in fridge until one morning she blasts it so loud the whole queue of commuters turns round and claps

tracks.title: つんつるてん浴衣
tracks.subject: a tall man who rents the last yukata left at a festival rental shop, a size too short so it stops at his shins, and decides to dance in the bon-odori circle anyway while the geta give him blisters

tracks.title: つり革なしのステップ
tracks.subject: a salaryman on a seventy-minute standing commute who never gets a strap, so he trains himself to ride the brakes and curves of the line with his knees like a disco step, and one day a schoolkid copies him

tracks.title: 金のひび
tracks.subject: a husband who cracks his wife's favourite rice bowl while washing up, buys a kintsugi kit and spends three weeks waiting for the lacquer to dry in a box under the sink, and she pretends not to notice until he gives it back with a gold line down the side

tracks.title: 押し入れの梅
tracks.mood: hushed, patient and a little funny
tracks.subject: a woman in a one-room apartment making umeboshi for the first time from a bag of supermarket ume, keeping the jar in the futon cupboard and opening it every night to check for mould, then drying the plums on her tiny balcony rail

tracks.title: 양머리 백일
tracks.subject: a young couple spending their hundredth-day night at a neighbourhood jjimjilbang in matching orange uniforms, where she ties his towel into a sheep-head and they split one baked egg and a can of sikhye on the heated floor

tracks.title: 여덟 시 오십 분 문방구
tracks.subject: a dad who learns at 8:40 a.m. that his daughter needs a 12-colour clay set and two sheets of coloured paper for class, and the old stationery-shop owner next to the elementary school who already has the bag packed because half the class came in before him

tracks.title: 막내 회원
tracks.subject: a 29-year-old office worker who joins his apartment complex's Sunday hiking club and is the only member under sixty, and the aunties who keep stuffing oranges, rice cakes and cucumber into his backpack at every rest stop until it is heavier at the top than at the start

tracks.title: 그림일기 몰아 쓰기
tracks.subject: a ten-year-old boy on the last night of summer vacation filling in thirty days of picture diary at once, and asking his older sister what the weather was on each day while she reads it off her own diary

tracks.title: 실리콘 다시 쏘는 밤
tracks.subject: a woman in her first rented flat who spends a Friday night scraping the black, mouldy silicone from around her bathtub with a cutter blade, taping the edges and running a fresh white bead, then not showering until Sunday so it can cure

tracks.title: Tersangkut di Karak
tracks.subject: a newly married couple stuck nine hours in the Hari Raya eve jam on the Karak Highway, the wife counting how many times her husband says 'dah nak sampai'

tracks.title: Kerusi Atas Meja
tracks.subject: a mamak shop worker at closing time hosing the floor and flipping chairs onto tables around the last two regulars who still won't get up

tracks.title: Beduk Pertama Mail
tracks.subject: a twelve-year-old boy allowed to strike the old surau beduk for maghrib for the first time, whose nervous first hit comes a beat early while the whole kampung waits

tracks.title: Musang King Dalam Bonet
tracks.subject: a man sneaking two Musang King durians home from a Raub roadside stall in his wife's new car, which she has banned durian from, and trying to air out the boot before she comes downstairs

tracks.title: Pinggan Ketiga
tracks.subject: a shy man at his aunt's Hari Raya rumah terbuka who keeps refilling the same guest's plate with rendang so he has a reason to stand next to her, until she is on her third plate and tells him to sit down and eat with her

tracks.title: 五十的上山 Gōo-tsa̍p ê Tsiūnn-suann
tracks.subject: a young man taking his girlfriend up Yangmingshan on his late-90s 50cc scooter, which dies on every hairpin bend so she climbs off and pushes while he steers, and at the top she says she likes it better than the bus

tracks.title: 無人看的戲 Bô Lâng Khuànn ê Hì
tracks.subject: a glove-puppet troupe playing a full afternoon show for the temple god's birthday to a row of empty plastic stools, one sleeping grandpa and a stray dog, so the young puppeteer starts dancing the hero to disco behind the stage curtain

tracks.title: 減糖的喜餅 Kiám-thn̂g ê Hí-piánn
tracks.subject: an old baker at a traditional cake shop pressing three hundred wedding cakes for a customer's order, and secretly baking one small batch with half the sugar for his wife, who is not allowed sweets since her diabetes check, so she can taste the wedding cake too

tracks.title: 火借我一下 Hué Tsioh Guá Tsi̍t-ē
tracks.subject: a young man doing his first 7th-month ghost-festival offering alone outside his rented ground-floor room, table set with instant noodles, beer and crisps, who realises he has no lighter and walks to the convenience store in slippers to borrow fire for three joss sticks

tracks.title: 跤底講的話 Kha-tué Kóng ê Uē
tracks.subject: an office worker's Friday-night foot massage at a small reflexology shop, where the old masseur presses one spot and announces he has been skipping lunch and lying about sleeping early, and he cannot argue because it hurts too much

tracks.title: สงกรานต์ไม่อยากเปียก (Dry Songkran)
tracks.subject: a Chiang Mai office worker walking to work on Songkran morning in a raincoat and swim goggles with her laptop wrapped in three plastic bags, ambushed at every corner by the same six-year-old with a water gun, until she buys a bigger gun herself

tracks.title: ตีสามที่เซเว่น (3 A.M. at the 7-Eleven)
tracks.subject: a man who walks down to the 7-Eleven at three in the morning to wait for his girlfriend coming off a late shift, buying two ham-and-cheese toasties and eating them with her on the shop step under the fluorescent sign

tracks.title: ตุ๊กตุ๊กใจดี (The Soft-Hearted Tuk-Tuk)
tracks.genre: contemporary Central Thai phleng choi repartee
tracks.subject: a tuk-tuk driver in Ayutthaya and his wife trading phleng choi verses over his habit of giving free rides to every monk, schoolkid and old lady in the soi, until she counts sixty baht for a whole day and decides to ride along to keep the meter herself

tracks.title: ไฟส่องแถวหลัง (The Spotlight Drifts Back)
tracks.subject: the follow-spot operator at a travelling mor lam stage show whose job is to keep the light on the lead singer, and the night his daughter dances in the back row for the first time he keeps letting the beam drift to her

tracks.title: แบ่งครึ่งไว้บนชั้น (Half Left on the Shelf)
tracks.subject: two flatmates who start leaving half of whatever they cook on the shared fridge shelf with a sticky note giving it a score out of ten, the scores and the notes getting longer until one note just asks if the other wants to eat it together tonight

tracks.title: Trả Giá Lúc Nửa Đêm
tracks.subject: a girl at the Tết flower market on the night of 28 Tết who wants one kumquat pot, watches the seller drop his price every hour, and waits him out until midnight while her friends beg to go home

tracks.title: Chiều Chủ Nhật Xích Lô
tracks.subject: a retired Hà Nội xích lô driver who still pedals his wife once round Hoàn Kiếm lake every Sunday afternoon, she in the passenger seat pretending to be a tourist asking the price

tracks.title: Ghế Nhựa Lùi Vô
tracks.subject: the owner of a sidewalk cà phê on a Sài Gòn street who drags her blue plastic stools back from the kerb every time the ward inspection motorbike turns the corner, and the regulars who stand up mid-sip and carry their own stools inside without being told

tracks.title: Khoai Lang Đầu Cầu Thang
tracks.subject: a bachelor on the fourth floor of an old Kim Liên collective block who finds a paper bag of warm roasted sweet potatoes on the stairwell landing every evening, and finally sits up on the steps one night to catch who leaves it

tracks.title: Nồi Phở Bốn Giờ Sáng
tracks.subject: a young phở cook who opens his own tiny shop and wakes at four every morning to skim the bone stock, talking to the pot as if it were a business partner while the street is still dark

tracks.title: 關公跌咗
tracks.subject: a red minibus driver whose little plastic Guan Yu figure falls off the dashboard on a corner, and he pulls over and refuses to move until the passengers find it under the seats

tracks.title: 千蚊紙冇人找
tracks.subject: a man who finds an old orange thousand-dollar note in a winter coat pocket and spends a whole day failing to get any shop to break it for a bun and a drink

tracks.title: 落枕
tracks.subject: a woman who wakes up with a cricked neck and can only turn her whole body, so all day her boss, her crush and a bus driver think she is snubbing them

tracks.title: 單底寫兩隻字
tracks.subject: a cha chaan teng cook who for twenty years has slipped a two-word note under each order slip he passes to his wife at the cashier counter

tracks.title: 最後一程搖搖馬
tracks.subject: residents of a public housing estate queueing on its last evening to take one final ride on the old spring rocking horse before the playground is rebuilt

tracks.title: 對講機只會聽
tracks.subject: a man whose old walk-up building's intercom handset can still hear the visitor downstairs but no longer transmits his voice, so for every delivery, friend and date he leans out of his seventh-floor window and lowers the gate key in a plastic basket on a rope

tracks.title: 腰圍放兩公分
tracks.subject: a man who secretly takes his girlfriend's favourite jeans, which have got tight since they started cooking dinner together, to the tailor in the alley to have the waist let out two centimetres, telling the tailor it is because she is happier now

tracks.title: 水寫布

tracks.subject: a woman in hay-fever season who secretly keeps count of how many times her boyfriend says bless you, and realises on the forty-first sneeze of April that he has never once missed one

tracks.subject: a man whose beagle comes home from the vet wearing a plastic cone after a minor operation and spends the week bumping into doorframes, the coffee table and the cat

tracks.title: Half-Mast
tracks.subject: a fourteen-year-old who grew three inches over the summer holidays and turns up on the first day of the new school year in last year's trousers, two inches above his socks, and decides to strut it out

tracks.title: Lutut Bunyi Krek
tracks.subject: a thirty-one-year-old man in Bekasi whose left knee cracks loudly every time he stands up, so he can never sneak out of a boring meeting, a sleeping baby's room or a cinema without everyone turning to look

tracks.title: Kandang Biru di Jok Belakang

tracks.title: Kursi Dekat Jendela

tracks.title: Satu Cap Lagi

tracks.title: 合鍵のステップ

tracks.genre: Korean Y2K hip-hop R&B dance pop

tracks.subject: a tenant moving out who argues with her landlord over every one of three nail holes he wants to deduct from her deposit, bringing her own photos from move-in day

tracks.title: 손가락 휘파람

tracks.genre: Malay neo-soul (Rhodes and live bass, ALYPH 'Ingat' lane)

tracks.title: 天光進前 Thinn-kng Tsìn-tsîng

tracks.subject: a husband who quietly fixes the wobbly leg of the old wooden writing desk his wife refuses to throw away, and pencils both their names under it

tracks.title: Beringin Kaleng Cat
tracks.subject: a pharmacy cashier in Medan who grows a bonsai banyan from a twig snapped off a roadside tree, in an old paint tin on the pharmacy's back steps, and trims it with nail clippers during breaks

tracks.title: 松の木さわれない

tracks.subject: a woman who, when her boyfriend's bike chain slips on the Han River cycle path, kneels and fixes it with bare hands, and he wipes the black grease off her fingers onto his own new white T-shirt

tracks.subject: a woman in her sixties complaining, half fond and half jealous, that her retired husband now spends every morning on their apartment veranda trimming a bonsai pine with tweezers and talking to it more than he talks to her

tracks.title: 케이크 높이 들어
tracks.subject: a woman racing through the Sindorim transfer at rush hour holding a whipped-cream birthday cake box above her head for her best friend's surprise party, apologising to every shoulder she squeezes past, and arriving with only one candle bent

tracks.title: Pin Tudung Pukul Enam
tracks.subject: a husband learning to pin his wife's tudung neatly every morning before her 7 a.m. shift because her right wrist is in a plaster cast, practising on a pillow the night before

tracks.title: Kucing Tuan Rumah
tracks.genre: Malay rockabilly (1950s rock and roll revival)
tracks.subject: a tenant in Petaling Jaya who gets fifty ringgit off his rent each month for bathing his landlady's huge, furious Persian cat called Datuk every Saturday

tracks.subject: a woman who rides the KL Monorail from end to end every Sunday morning with a pencil, solving one page of a Malay crossword book per round trip

tracks.title: Termos Biru
tracks.genre: Malay piano soul-pop ballad (Ara Johari lane)
tracks.subject: a woman returning a blue thermos flask to her old university housemate six years later, her housemate's name still on masking tape on the lid, and the two of them filling it with teh tarik for the drive home

tracks.title: Sepuluh Lagi, Abang
tracks.genre: KL rempit club (Malay gabber-breakcore with kompang)

tracks.title: 鳳梨醋咧喘氣 Ông-lâi-tshòo Teh Tshuán-khuì
tracks.subject: a young woman fermenting her first jar of pineapple vinegar on her apartment balcony, opening the lid every night to hear it fizz and talking to it like a pet

tracks.title: 佮松仔冤家 Kah Tshîng-á Uan-ke
tracks.subject: a retired man who has argued with the same twenty-year-old bonsai juniper on his rooftop every morning, scissors in hand, because it keeps growing a branch he never asked for

tracks.title: 五十粒雞胿仔 Gōo-tsa̍p Lia̍p Ke-kui-á
tracks.subject: a father blowing up fifty balloons by mouth the night before his daughter's sixth birthday because he forgot to buy a pump, getting dizzier with every one

tracks.title: 鏡面的字 Kiànn-bīn ê Jī

tracks.title: 欠一个蓋仔 Khiàm Tsi̍t Ê Kuà-á
tracks.subject: a man who broke the lid of his everyday clay teapot and spends every Sunday at the Fuhe Bridge flea market trying lids from stranger teapots until an old lady sells him one that fits

tracks.genre: Thai melodic hip-hop ballad with live band

tracks.genre: Andaman rong ngeng revival dance song

tracks.title: Lá Thứ Bảy
tracks.subject: a Hà Nội man keeping his girlfriend's monstera alive while she is posted to Đà Nẵng for three months, sending her a photo every time it opens a new leaf

tracks.title: Bảy Con Ốc Thừa
tracks.subject: a young man in a Thủ Đức apartment assembling a flat-pack wardrobe over a whole Sunday, finishing with seven screws left over, and the wardrobe standing anyway

tracks.title: Con Vẹt Bấm Còi
tracks.subject: a parrot in a Gò Vấp alley in Sài Gòn that learns to copy its owner's scooter horn, so every neighbour keeps stepping aside for a motorbike that never comes

tracks.title: Cuốn Từ Điển Mượn
tracks.subject: a man returning, fifteen years late, the English dictionary he borrowed from his high-school teacher in Quy Nhơn, with her pencil notes still in the margins

tracks.title: 紙皮箱貓
tracks.subject: a man who spends eight hundred dollars on a fancy padded cat bed, and his cat ignores it to sleep in the cardboard box it was delivered in

tracks.subject: two flatmates who cannot sleep making red bean soup at two in the morning in a tiny Sham Shui Po kitchen, dancing around the pot while it simmers

tracks.title: 花墟細盆栽

tracks.title: 第二顆鈕扣
tracks.mood: tender, warm and a little shy

tracks.title: 倉鼠越獄

tracks.subject: a woman whose boyfriend's model railway slowly takes over their dining table track by track, until they eat dinner on the sofa and the little train delivers the soy sauce

tracks.title: Burung Kakatua Pak Udin

tracks.title: Seragam Jangan Dicuci
tracks.subject: a girl on her last day of SMA whose white uniform shirt is covered in friends' marker signatures, hiding it in her cupboard so her mother will not put it in the wash

tracks.title: ベランダ・プール

tracks.title: チョキしか出せない
tracks.mood: teasing, warm and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a young man who loses rock-paper-scissors to his girlfriend every burnable-garbage morning over who takes the bags out, and admits in the song that he knows she always throws rock and plays scissors on purpose so he can walk her to the corner

tracks.title: 五時五十八分
tracks.subject: a man who takes a day off to wait for the plumber to fix a dripping kitchen tap, told only 'sometime between nine and six', counting the drips into a measuring cup all day until the plumber rings the bell at 5:58 and fixes it in four minutes

tracks.title: 名前入りの弁当箱
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old woman who finds her old primary-school bento box at her mother's house with her name still written on the lid in her mother's marker, takes it back to the city and starts carrying lunch to the office in it, and her colleague asks whose name that is

tracks.title: 환승 에스컬레이터
tracks.subject: a man who rides the long transfer escalator up with his girlfriend every evening only to say goodbye at the top and ride straight back down alone

tracks.title: 벽 색깔 샘플
tracks.subject: a tenant who tapes six paint-colour samples on her rental wall and lives with them for a week while waiting for the landlord to reply

tracks.title: 새 안경
tracks.subject: walking out of the optician with a new prescription and noticing the individual leaves on a street tree for the first time in years

tracks.title: 영수증이 지워졌어요
tracks.subject: a man trying to get a warranty repair on a stick vacuum when the thermal-paper receipt in his drawer has faded completely blank

tracks.title: 일요일 어항 청소
tracks.subject: a man's Sunday ritual of cleaning the tank of the goldfish he won at a school fair eleven years ago, which now outweighs every other fish in the shop

tracks.title: Cermin Mata Pertama
tracks.genre: Malay bossa-samba jazz-club pop (Dendang Raya lane)
tracks.subject: a woman taking her boyfriend for his first pair of glasses at an optical shop in Bangsar, and the moment he puts them on and finally sees her face clearly

tracks.title: Harga Rak Lain
tracks.genre: Malay chart pop-rap duet (Garam & Madu lane)
tracks.subject: a customer and a hypermarket cashier arguing in rhyme when a pack of biscuits scans at RM12.90 but the shelf tag says RM8.90, while the queue behind them takes sides

tracks.title: Abang Din Paip
tracks.genre: Malay country-folk with harmonica (1980s Kembara lane)
tracks.subject: a plumber called Abang Din who comes to fix a dripping kitchen tap, finds three more leaks, and stays for teh o while the pipes are off

tracks.title: Ikan Laga Bilik Sewa
tracks.genre: Malay lo-fi hip-hop (chill beat with sung hook)
tracks.subject: a young man in a rented room in Shah Alam who changes his one betta fish's water every Sunday night and talks to it about his week

tracks.title: Cha-Cha Kolam Awam
tracks.subject: a thirty-five-year-old man taking swimming lessons at a public pool on Saturday mornings in the same class as six-year-olds, who cheer the day he finally floats

tracks.title: 洗喙齒的恰恰 Sé Tshuì-khí ê Tshiah-tshiah
tracks.mood: nervous, then playful and swinging, a dance-floor comedy in a dental chair
tracks.subject: a grown man terrified of a teeth cleaning whose hygienist hums a salsa under her mask and counts the scaling in clave so he keeps his mouth open to the beat

tracks.title: 十一冬的工具箱 Tsa̍p-it Tang ê Kang-kū-siunn
tracks.mood: driving, warm and a little sheepish, a road song with a big open chorus
tracks.subject: a man driving a red metal toolbox down to Changhua to return it to the coworker who lent it eleven years ago, every wrench still wrapped in the newspaper he packed it in

tracks.title: 新目鏡 Sin Ba̍k-kiànn
tracks.mood: tender, slow-burning and smiling, a real love duet between two old people
tracks.subject: an old couple at a neighbourhood optician, where she spends an hour choosing his new frames and he says he only agrees because the first face he sees through them is hers

tracks.title: 金魚仔大王 Kim-hî-á Tāi-ông
tracks.mood: bouncy, mock-grand and silly, a stomping comedy
tracks.subject: a man who buys his single fat goldfish ever more expensive imported pellets, which it spits out every time, until it gobbles the cheapest flakes from the corner shop

tracks.title: 發票白去矣 Huat-phiò Pe̍h--khì--ah
tracks.mood: frantic, wry and dancing, a shop-counter farce that ends friendly
tracks.subject: a woman taking a broken electric fan back to the appliance shop with a receipt so faded it is blank paper, she and the young clerk tilting it under the lamp to read the date

tracks.title: แว่นแรก (First Glasses)
tracks.genre: Isan molam sing (fast electric phin dance)
tracks.subject: a Khon Kaen rice-truck driver at his first eye test who reads the letter chart wrong with total confidence and then sees the price of the frames

tracks.title: สีที่สิบห้า (The Fifteenth Colour)
tracks.genre: Thai Bakery Music-era alternative pop revival
tracks.mood: warm, unhurried and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a couple painting fifteen sample squares of almost-identical off-white on the wall of their first rented room and choosing by lamplight at midnight

tracks.title: ใบเสร็จจาง (Faded Receipt)
tracks.subject: trying to return a pair of too-short trousers at a department store refund counter with a thermal receipt that has faded to blank paper

tracks.title: เหมียวใต้ม้านั่ง (Cat Under the Bench)
tracks.mood: gentle, fond and a little comic
tracks.subject: a woman at a Nonthaburi vet clinic coaxing her ginger cat out from under the waiting-room bench for its yearly vaccine while a large dog watches politely

tracks.title: หนังสือที่ยืมครู (The Teacher's Book)
tracks.subject: a man in his forties posting back a dog-eared Thai poetry book he borrowed from his primary-school teacher thirty years ago, with a short letter tucked at page forty

tracks.title: Màu Cửa Nhà Tôi
tracks.subject: a woman in Đà Lạt arguing with an old house painter over the colour of her front door, rejecting eleven sample patches on the wall until he quietly mixes the exact faded blue of the door she grew up with

tracks.title: Cái Quạt Bằng Bàn Tay
tracks.mood: petty, cheeky and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a Hà Nội student who orders a cheap standing fan online during a sale and receives a fan the size of his palm, then spends a week arguing with the shop's chat for a refund and ends up keeping it on his desk

tracks.title: Bé Mập Ăn Kiêng
tracks.subject: a Biên Hòa woman whose round corgi is put on a strict diet by the vet, and who keeps slipping it pieces of bánh tráng under the table until the next weigh-in shows it gained half a kilo

tracks.title: Lịch Hẹn Ba Tháng
tracks.subject: a young man in Vĩnh Long who books a teeth cleaning every three months only to see the dental nurse, until she writes her phone number on the back of his appointment card

tracks.title: Lớp Bơi Tám Tuổi
tracks.subject: a thirty-year-old Hà Nội office worker who signs up for summer swimming lessons at a public pool and ends up in a class of eight-year-olds who teach him to blow bubbles

tracks.title: 貼紙樽
tracks.subject: a woman staying over at her boyfriend's flat who writes masking-tape labels for every unmarked jar in his kitchen, and he keeps them all even the wrong ones

tracks.title: 張單冇咗字
tracks.mood: frantic, cheeky, laughing at bad luck
tracks.subject: a man trying to return a broken desk fan to a Wan Chai electrical shop with a thermal-paper receipt that has faded completely blank

tracks.title: 浮唔起
tracks.subject: a forty-two-year-old woman in an adult beginners' swimming class at a Kowloon public pool who cannot float without her kickboard, until the coach quietly lets go

tracks.title: 金魚第三年
tracks.subject: a ten-dollar goldfish won for a girlfriend's niece that nobody wanted, now three years old in its third bigger tank in a Tai Kok Tsui flat

tracks.title: 三十二隻白
tracks.subject: a couple choosing a wall colour for their first 300-square-foot flat from thirty-two almost identical white paint chips at a Mong Kok hardware shop

tracks.title: 四十八種白
tracks.subject: a man in an empty rental flat holding up forty-eight paint swatches that are all slightly different whites while his girlfriend chooses, and he paints the wall in the one she calls 'morning milk'

tracks.title: 五塊錢的郵票
tracks.subject: a young man who buys a 1980 monkey-year-looking stamp at a Sunday flea market for five yuan, sure it is worth a fortune, and the old appraiser with a magnifier tells him it is worth exactly five yuan

tracks.title: 穿拖鞋的凌晨一點
tracks.subject: a woman who locks herself out in pyjamas and slippers while taking out the rubbish at 1 a.m., and the locksmith who arrives in a dinosaur-print jacket and opens the door in eleven seconds

tracks.title: 牙線週
tracks.subject: a man who has not flossed in a year and flosses ostentatiously for the seven days before his dental check-up, and the hygienist who sees his bleeding gums and says 'only started this week, huh'

tracks.title: 嗶不過的閘門
tracks.subject: a commuter whose transit card fails at the same metro ticket gate every morning, and the station attendant who starts waiting by that gate to wave him through, until he buys a new card and walks to her window anyway

tracks.title: No Receipt, No Problem
tracks.mood: cocky, petty and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a Newark guy trying to return a pair of white trainers to a shoe store with no receipt, arguing with the teenage clerk over the scuff on the left toe, and walking out with store credit for exactly one pair of socks

tracks.title: Sunday Collars
tracks.subject: a woman teaching her new boyfriend to iron his own work shirts on a Sunday night: steam hissing, collars first, and the one blue shirt he scorches, which she keeps as a nightshirt

tracks.title: It Comes Back Black
tracks.subject: a London renter at war with a black mould patch on her bathroom ceiling that returns every three weeks no matter how much bleach she uses, until the landlord finally sends someone to fix the extractor fan

tracks.title: Shell on Seven Mile
tracks.subject: a Detroit man whose forty-year-old pet tortoise Big Ron escapes the backyard and is found three blocks away at the car wash on Seven Mile, where the whole crew starts chanting his name

tracks.title: Garage Line
tracks.subject: a retired bus mechanic in Fresno whose HO-scale model railway grows out of the spare room, across the hallway and through a hole in the garage wall, until his wife's car is parked on the street and she asks for a station named after her

tracks.title: Setengah Cokelat Setengah Kacang
tracks.subject: a young couple in Bandung at midnight with money for only one martabak manis, arguing chocolate-cheese against peanut at the cart on Dago until they order it half and half and end up feeding each other the other side

tracks.title: Member Januari
tracks.genre: East Java sound horeg battle-bass DJ
tracks.subject: a man in Surabaya who signs up at a shophouse gym on the second of January, goes exactly once, and keeps paying the monthly auto-debit all year while the receptionist still waves at him by name

tracks.title: Botol Teh Mbak Sri
tracks.subject: a young man in Ngawi who drinks bottled tea every day to fill a sack for the kampung waste bank, just to stand at the Sunday scale while Mbak Sri, who runs it, weighs plastic and writes balances in her ledger without looking up

tracks.title: Jenderal di Atas Atap
tracks.genre: Indonesian late-80s slow rock power ballad
tracks.subject: a man in Tanah Abang keeping six chickens on his rooftop whose rooster Jenderal crows from the water tank at four every morning and wakes the whole gang, until the bubur seller thanks him for never being late

tracks.title: Saldo Kurang
tracks.subject: a young office worker at Tebet KRL station who keeps his commuter card balance low on purpose because the woman behind him at the ticket gate always taps him through with hers and lets him pay her back with a bottle of iced tea

tracks.title: ネジが一本足りない
tracks.mood: flustered, cocky and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a man assembling a flat-pack wardrobe alone on a Saturday, discovering one screw is missing so a door hangs crooked, while a wooden dowel is somehow left over and fits no hole

tracks.title: 最後に来たのはいつですか
tracks.subject: a man who has dodged the dentist for three years, finally walks in with a cracked filling, and freezes when the hygienist asks when he last came

tracks.title: ツナマヨふたつ
tracks.subject: two regulars at the same konbini at 11pm who keep reaching for the last tuna-mayo onigiri, until one night he buys two and hands her one, and they eat side by side at the guardrail outside

tracks.title: ボックスシーツのたたみかた
tracks.subject: a twenty-something living alone who finds a children's-TV-style how-to song in his head while trying, and failing, to fold a fitted bedsheet with elastic corners on a Sunday afternoon

tracks.title: ビート板は二枚まで
tracks.subject: a forty-two-year-old office worker in a ward-pool adult beginners' swimming class on Thursday nights, the oldest of six, finally letting go of his second kickboard and making twenty-five metres of crawl while the seventy-year-old woman in the next lane cheers

tracks.title: 왼발부터
tracks.mood: shy, giggly and slowly falling in step
tracks.subject: a couple in their thirties taking a Tuesday-night beginners' social tango class at the ward community centre, stepping on each other's feet for weeks, counting under their breath, until one night they get through a whole song without looking down

tracks.title: 오픈 기념
tracks.subject: a college student working a one-day part-time job inside a giant smiling SIM-card mascot costume outside a phone shop's grand opening in July, dancing every time the MC shouts 'music!', unable to see more than a mesh slit, high-fiving kids and a confused delivery rider

tracks.title: 싱크대 밑에
tracks.subject: a young man who adopts a grey shelter cat that hides under his kitchen sink for nine days; he sits on the kitchen floor every evening reading the instructions on ramen packets aloud until on the ninth night the cat walks out and sits on his foot

tracks.title: 열 번만 더
tracks.subject: a man rehabbing a sprained ankle at a neighbourhood physiotherapy clinic, doing calf raises and resistance-band pulls while his strict physiotherapist counts out loud and keeps saying 'ten more' every time he reaches ten

tracks.title: 몬스테라
tracks.subject: a man in a one-room studio whose small monstera bought at a flower market grows a new split leaf every week until it blocks the window, covers the TV and claims half his single bed, and he keeps rearranging his life around it instead of pruning

tracks.title: Manual Bahasa Cina
tracks.genre: Malay Afropop (Afrobeats pop with Malay melody)
tracks.subject: friends assembling a big trampoline for the kids at a Hari Raya open house, the instruction manual printed only in Chinese

tracks.title: Teh Tarik Bergambar
tracks.mood: warm, shy and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a teh tarik puller at an Ipoh kopitiam who makes the same drink for one woman every morning and finally draws something in the foam

tracks.title: Baju Yang Sama
tracks.genre: Malay cinematic folk-rock with French-pop melody (Noh Salleh lane)
tracks.subject: a tailor in Kampung Baru who has to let out the same customer's baju Melayu every week before Raya because he keeps eating at buka puasa bazaars

tracks.title: Latihan Kebakaran
tracks.subject: an office's monthly fire drill in a KL tower, everyone walking down 23 floors to the assembly point still carrying their nasi lemak

tracks.title: Empat Puluh Kunci
tracks.genre: Brunei-Malay traditional pop fusion (Aziz Harun lane)
tracks.subject: a tenant locked out in the evening and an elderly landlord arriving with a ring of forty unlabelled keys, trying every one on the grille door while they chat

tracks.title: 媽祖宮的榕仔 Má-tsóo-king ê Tshîng-á
tracks.mood: fond, gently swaggering and unhurried, a mid-tempo singalong about a morning routine
tracks.subject: an old man who sweeps the fallen banyan leaves in a Mazu temple courtyard every dawn and chats to the tree, and after one morning off sick finds a mountain of leaves waiting, which he takes as the tree missing him

tracks.title: 熱水器歹去矣 Jia̍t-tsuí-khì Pháinn--khì-ah
tracks.mood: shivering and indignant, then laughing, a street-corner complaint you can dance to
tracks.subject: a man whose gas water heater dies mid-shower on the coldest night of the Taipei winter, who boils pot after pot of water to rinse the shampoo out, only for the repairman to find next morning that the gas tank was simply empty

tracks.title: 牆仔欲漆啥物色 Tshiûnn-á Beh Tshat Siánn-mi̍h Sik
tracks.mood: warm, easy and smitten, a slow-dance love song
tracks.subject: a young couple choosing a paint colour for their first rented flat in Tainan, twelve sample patches daubed on the wall, arguing mint green against milk white at sunset, then painting half each until their rollers meet in the middle and she writes his name in the corner before painting over it

tracks.title: 鵝仔來矣 Gô-á Lâi--ah
tracks.mood: frantic, silly and bouncy, a chase-scene dance track
tracks.subject: a fierce goose nicknamed the Sergeant at a Yilan farm guesthouse that charges every tour group off the bus, stealing an auntie's sun hat, until one quiet teenager crouches down and buys peace with a sweet-potato cake

tracks.title: 歪膏的頷巾 Uai-ko ê Ām-kin
tracks.mood: wry, tender and warm, a clumsy gift told with a grin
tracks.subject: a man secretly knitting his wife a scarf at midnight from online video tutorials, pausing and rewinding every stitch, who runs out of grey yarn and knits a green row through the middle, and on New Year's Eve she wears it and offers him the longer end

tracks.title: ซ้อมมวยหลังเลิกงาน (After-Work Muay Thai)
tracks.subject: office workers in an after-work Muay Thai fitness class (a workout, not a fight), the trainer shouting for twenty more kicks while the accountant and the IT guy collapse on the mat, and everyone limping to work the next morning

tracks.title: ต้อนเป็ดข้ามถนน (Ducks Across the Road)
tracks.subject: a boy herding his family's two hundred ducks across a provincial highway at dusk with a bamboo pole and a red bag, while a ten-wheel truck and a pickup wait, and counting them all again on the far bank

tracks.title: รอน้ำพร้อม (Waiting for the Water)
tracks.subject: a couple who set up their first fish tank in a Nonthaburi condo and must wait six weeks for the water to cycle before buying a single betta, testing the water strip together every night

tracks.title: หมีตัวโตขึ้นวิน (Big Bear on the Bike Taxi)
tracks.subject: a woman who wins a giant pink teddy bear at a temple-fair ring toss and has to ride home on a motorcycle taxi with the bear squeezed between her and the driver, its ears covering his eyes

tracks.title: จีบนิ้วหน้ากระจก (Jeeb in the Mirror)
tracks.subject: a schoolgirl practising Thai classical dance hand curves (jeeb) in the wardrobe mirror every night for her school's Wai Khru day, her little brother copying her from the doorway with tangled fingers

tracks.title: Ly Thứ Tư
tracks.subject: four students cramming for a finals exam at a Sài Gòn café until two in the morning, ordering a fourth round of cà phê sữa đá while nobody has turned past page twelve

tracks.title: Băng Cát-Xét Duy Nhất
tracks.subject: a man fixing his late-90s National radio cassette player on the porch with a screwdriver and a pencil, and it only ever plays the one cassette left inside it, a worn Chế Linh tape

tracks.title: Cà Phê Trứng Bảy Giờ
tracks.subject: a Sài Gòn guy living in Hà Nội who whisks egg coffee every morning before work, failing for weeks, until he finally gets the thick foam his girlfriend loves from the café on Hàng Gai

tracks.title: Mảnh Ghép Cuối
tracks.subject: a woman spending a month of evenings on a 2000-piece Hạ Long Bay jigsaw on her living-room floor, finding the last piece missing, and cutting a stand-in from the box lid and painting it with a child's watercolours

tracks.title: Đứng Bên Phải Nha
tracks.subject: two friends riding the new Bến Thành - Suối Tiên metro escalators in its first months, one always standing on the left and blocking the people walking up, until the whole platform starts chanting at him

tracks.title: 張大口
tracks.mood: cheeky, flustered and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a man at a dental scaling whose hygienist keeps asking him chatty questions while his mouth is propped open, so every answer comes out as 'ah' and she guesses wrong each time

tracks.title: 排到天光
tracks.subject: a man queuing at 6am outside a famous Hong Kong bakery for the fresh egg tarts his sleeping girlfriend wants, befriending an old regular with a stool, a woman doing her make-up and a paid queue-sitter

tracks.title: 同一盞燈
tracks.subject: two strangers who each bought the same old brass desk lamp at a Sham Shui Po flea-market stall meet when both come back for the one matching shade, and agree to share it

tracks.title: 皮鞋上獅子山
tracks.subject: a man who loses a bet to his friend and must hike up Lion Rock in brand-new leather office shoes, blistering, slipping and overtaken by grannies, then walking down barefoot

tracks.title: 一定係二
tracks.subject: a woman getting her first pair of glasses at thirty-one after an optician's 'one or two' lens test, walking out to find bus-stop signs, single tree leaves, and her partner waving from across the crossing suddenly sharp

tracks.title: 一個釘孔三百塊
tracks.subject: a young tenant moving out of a Taipei rental whose landlord walks the walls with a torch charging NT$300 for every nail hole, until he digs up his move-in photos proving three of the holes were already there

tracks.title: 你幫我挑的鏡框
tracks.subject: a very short-sighted man whose girlfriend picks his new frames at an optician by putting pair after pair on his face, and who, wearing the new lenses three days later, sees for the first time that she has more freckles on her left cheek

tracks.title: 九十九朵送錯樓
tracks.mood: frantic, cheeky and out of breath
tracks.subject: a florist's delivery boy who carries a 99-rose bouquet to floor 21 instead of floor 12, and has to talk it back off the receptionist who has already put it in a water bucket and photographed it for her mum, trading her a bunch of baby's breath to get it

tracks.title: 標籤寫三十九
tracks.subject: a shopper who finds the yellow shelf tag on a pack of toilet paper says 39 but the till rings 49, marches the cashier back to the shelf, makes the manager rip the tag down with his price gun, and an old man behind him quietly brings his own pack over too

tracks.title: 又胖了零點八
tracks.subject: a young woman whose shiba inu Xiaomi has gained 0.8 kg on the vet's scale because her grandmother secretly feeds it sweet potato, who starts extra evening walks past the roast sweet-potato cart, and at the recheck the dog is 300 g lighter while she has gained a kilo

tracks.title: One Waffle Each
tracks.subject: a British tourist at a Vienna hotel breakfast buffet who sets her alarm for six fifty-five every morning of the holiday to beat a German family to the only flip-over waffle iron, and on the last day finds the dad has left her the batter jug and a waffle already turning

tracks.title: Coach Twelve, Seat Sixty-One
tracks.subject: two strangers stuck for four hours on a Eurostar halted in a field outside Lille split the one tin of sardines, a squashed baguette and a clementine she had packed, swap numbers on the back of a ticket, and a year later book the same train, coach and seats on purpose, bringing two tins this time

tracks.title: Rocks on the Windowsill
tracks.subject: a woman whose boyfriend spends every weekend splitting shale in a disused Yorkshire quarry and fills her flat with ammonites on the windowsills, a trilobite in the butter dish and a hammer in the dishwasher, and she lists it all while not quite asking him to stop

tracks.title: Shake That Tree, Darlene
tracks.subject: an old Texas couple bringing in their pecan harvest in November with a tree shaker borrowed from the co-op for one afternoon only, the husband clamping the trunk while his wife drives the sweeper, nuts bouncing off the truck roof, both racing the co-op man who is coming at four to take the shaker back

tracks.title: Ride-On Through Bolton
tracks.subject: a council grounds worker in Bolton who mows the roundabouts and grass verges on a ride-on mower every summer, waves at the same bus driver at the same roundabout each morning, and spares one patch of wild orchids on the ring road verge that she tapes off with her own bunting

tracks.title: Lewat Harmoni
tracks.subject: a Jakarta commuter on TransJakarta who teaches the woman standing beside him how to transfer at Harmoni from the Blok M line to the Kalideres line, every morning for two weeks, until one day they both stay on the bus past Harmoni on purpose

tracks.title: Pesanan Kopi Lantai Tujuh
tracks.subject: a first-job intern on the seventh floor of a Jakarta office whose only task for three weeks is photocopying, until his supervisor finally trusts him to take and place the whole office's afternoon coffee order

tracks.title: Kelas Memanjat
tracks.subject: a keeper at an orangutan rehabilitation centre in East Kalimantan who spends every morning of forest school coaxing one orphaned young orangutan off her back and onto a liana, counting the metres it climbs before it slides down to her again

tracks.title: Beo Pian
tracks.subject: a Banjarmasin man whose talking myna was meant to learn a pantun for the bird show, but only ever learned his wife's voice calling him home from the riverside coffee stall, and now shouts it at him in front of his friends

tracks.title: Huruf Nenek
tracks.subject: a young man in Makassar learning the Bugis lontara script letter by letter from a primary-school workbook so he can read the folded letters his grandmother sent him while he worked in a Malaysian palm-oil plantation, which he kept for six years without ever reading

tracks.title: トング係
tracks.mood: flustered, eager and finally triumphant, a workplace comedy you can dance to
tracks.subject: a new hire at her first welcome party (歓迎会) at a yakiniku restaurant, handed the tongs by her section chief and put in charge of grilling for the whole table of eight, juggling who wants their meat rare, the burning tare and the chief's order of tongue first

tracks.title: こたつで千ピース
tracks.mood: hyperactive, nerdy and stubbornly proud, a grandpa's personal-best comedy
tracks.subject: a retired salaryman alone at the kotatsu over one winter weekend, timing himself on a stopwatch to finish the 1000-piece Mount Fuji jigsaw his grandson did in nine hours at New Year, sorting edge pieces into a biscuit tin and losing an hour to a sky made of nothing but blue

tracks.title: ハウスの朝
tracks.subject: a young couple who grow strawberries in Moka, Tochigi, picking tochiaika in the greenhouse at 5:30 on January mornings; he packs the boxes so she can pick at her own pace, and they split a can of hot oshiruko on the way back from the farm stand

tracks.title: 開かねえ
tracks.subject: a young man in Asahikawa at six in the morning at minus twenty-five whose car door handle and lock are frozen solid before work, scraping ice with a point card and warming the key with a lighter, until he gets in through the passenger door

tracks.title: 挟まれたもみじ
tracks.subject: a ward library staffer in November who keeps finding a pressed maple leaf inside different returned books each week, is not allowed to check the borrowing records to find out who, and one morning tucks a ginkgo leaf into the book as a reply

tracks.title: 곗돈 장부
tracks.subject: the narrator keeps the shared money book and the cash envelope for four school friends saving 50,000 won each a month for their first trip abroad together (Fukuoka), while one friend, Minjae, keeps 'borrowing' from it, until the narrator opens the envelope and finds Minjae has paid it all back with interest and a note saying to go get passport photos

tracks.title: 오백 원 저금병
tracks.subject: a girl who drops every 500-won coin into a narrow-necked drink bottle from January on to buy her best friend a birthday present, then finds the coins won't come back out through the neck, fishes for three hours with chopsticks and a hairpin, and ends up tying a ribbon on the whole bottle

tracks.title: 그늘막 점프
tracks.mood: sweaty, cheeky, dancing through the heat
tracks.subject: a man in Daegu during a 38-degree August heatwave who walks to a first date by hopping from one shade parasol at the crosswalks to the next, timing each dash to the walk signal, and arrives with his shirt soaked anyway

tracks.title: 칠 층까지 다시 칠해 주세요
tracks.subject: a young delivery rider who relies every evening on the floor numbers painted on the landings of an old walk-up apartment block, and the block's elderly caretaker (경비 아저씨) who repaints the faded numbers one landing per evening with a tape measure, finishing the seventh floor on the evening of the first snow

tracks.title: 스티커 붙였다고
tracks.subject: a man who buys a large-waste disposal sticker at the community centre for his old single mattress, gets the size category wrong, and watches the mattress sit untouched in the alley for two weeks with a pink 'wrong sticker' slip taped to it

tracks.title: Mesin Ais Lalu
tracks.subject: the driver of the ice resurfacing machine at a shopping-mall ice rink in Kuala Lumpur who clears the skaters off every two hours and crawls the machine round the rink at walking pace while forty teenagers wait at the gate

tracks.title: Bajet Atas Tisu
tracks.genre: bright piano-soul pop with brass (Tulus lane)
tracks.subject: a young man on his first payslip who sits at a kopitiam and budgets every ringgit on a paper napkin so he can take his girlfriend to the Italian restaurant in Bangsar she always pointed at through the glass

tracks.title: Tarik Tali Tin
tracks.subject: a Kelantan paddy farmer and his wife at harvest, taking turns all day in the bamboo hut at the edge of their plot pulling the long string of rattling tin cans to scare the burung pipit off the ripening grain, him pretending he is not tired while she brings the kopi in a tin can

tracks.title: Tali Lanyard Pejabat
tracks.subject: a young man alone in his newly rented room in Shah Alam whose curtain rod falls down every night with a crash; on the third night he gives up on the screws, ties the curtain back with his office lanyard and sleeps facing the orange streetlight outside the window

tracks.title: Sesenti, Seratus Tahun
tracks.subject: a cave guide at Gua Tempurung in Perak leading a noisy school group through the limestone chambers, telling them over and over not to touch the stalactites because the oil on their hands stops the stone growing and one centimetre takes about a hundred years

tracks.title: 搖鈴仔的阿伯 Iô Lîng-á ê A-peh
tracks.mood: cheeky, skipping and proud, a whole school dancing to one old man's wrist
tracks.subject: the electric school bell at a Taiwanese primary school breaks for a week and the old school caretaker rings the periods by hand with a rusty brass handbell from the storeroom, until the pupils refuse to go in when the repaired bell returns

tracks.title: 會行路的洗衫機 Ē Kiânn-lōo ê Sé-sann-ki
tracks.mood: sunny, brassy and giddy, a bargain that dances off across the kitchen
tracks.subject: an auntie who haggles across three towns' secondhand shops for one used washing machine, gets it home for 3,500 with a free hose, and on its first spin cycle it walks across the kitchen while her husband, son and daughter chase it, until the daughter sits on it and her husband wedges a wood chip under its short leg

tracks.title: 接枝 Tsiap-ki
tracks.mood: tender, sly and patient, a husband keeping a three-year secret in a tree
tracks.subject: a husband secretly grafting Irwin (aiwen) mango scions onto the sour native mango tree his grandfather planted behind the house, because his wife buys Irwin mangoes at the market every year, and three summers later the tree fruits both kinds

tracks.title: 國民法官六號 Kok-bîn Huat-kuann La̍k-hō
tracks.subject: an ordinary man drawn by lot as citizen judge number six (Taiwan's citizen judge system) for a six-day fraud trial, who may tell no one, tells his wife it's a business trip, eats cold pork-chop lunchboxes in silence with five strangers, and casts his vote

tracks.title: 九降風的菜脯 Káu-kàng-hong ê Tshài-póo
tracks.mood: hazy, tender and windswept, a long dry winter on a rooftop
tracks.subject: a granddaughter spending one dry, windy Hsinchu winter on the rooftop with her living grandmother making sun-dried radish (菜脯): weeks of salting, turning the radish morning and night on bamboo trays in the northeast 'nine-descending' wind, while the grandmother talks about working the salt pans and the salty radish grandpa brought when he first came courting

tracks.title: ตำนี้ใครกินไหว (Who Can Eat This Somtam)
tracks.mood: rowdy, sweaty and laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a Bangkok office's Friday pot-luck where Pae from purchasing brings a somtam made with thirty bird's-eye chillies; one bite each sends the whole 14th floor queueing at the water cooler, while the narrator calmly keeps eating and becomes the only person Pae will pound it for

tracks.title: ไพ่ตองของยาย (Grandma's Tong Cards)
tracks.subject: a man spending his first Songkran at his girlfriend's family home learning her grandmother's tong card game to win the family over, losing every hand for three days, until the grandmother deals to him first and calls him หลาน

tracks.title: อ่านได้หมด (I Can Read Them All)
tracks.subject: a Roi Et rice farmer on his first trip abroad, a temple tour bus to Vientiane his daughter paid for, who bets the Lao driver a crate of Beerlao that he can read every Lao shop sign because it is nearly Isan, and loses to a French bakery sign and the railway station sign he reads as a discount on lights

tracks.title: สูบน้ำคืนเดือนสาม (Pumping Water in the Third Month)
tracks.subject: a young man running the diesel pump every dry-season night onto his family's shallot beds on the Chi river bank in Maha Sarakham, and the young woman who runs the pump on the next plot; they talk across the ditch over the engine noise until he offers to carry her pipe

tracks.title: บลูเบอร์รี่ป่า (Wild Blueberries)
tracks.mood: tired, wry and homesick but grinning
tracks.subject: a Chaiyaphum man on his third summer picking wild blueberries in the forests of Finnish Lapland, counting buckets at the scale each evening, cooking sticky rice in a borrowed school kitchen, and noticing the August sun is still up at eleven at night

tracks.title: Vạch Nước Sáu Giờ
tracks.subject: a man who rides onto Long Biên Bridge at six every morning to watch the woman he loves read the Red River water-level gauge staff below, learning the name of every painted mark until she says that is enough to meet her mother

tracks.title: Xô Thứ Một Nghìn
tracks.genre: Vietnamese experimental folk-rap with metal percussion
tracks.subject: a hired crew of four and the family alone (husband, wife, their teenage son, the wife's brother) pouring their Hanoi house's concrete roof slab in one morning by bucket chain, the wife's mother on a plastic stool writing down whoever passes slowly, and the eight of them sitting on the still-wet roof when she finally opens the beer

tracks.title: Diều Đê Ngõ Chợ
tracks.subject: kids of one Hanoi alley off the Yên Phụ dike road hauling every kite they own up onto the dike on one windy dry-season afternoon, trying to keep as many in the air at once as they can, until their strings tangle with the kites from the next alley and both gangs end up on the slope unknotting them together (not a formal contest)

tracks.title: Rồi Răng Nữa?
tracks.subject: an old woman in a Huế garden house reading aloud on the porch the letters from her late-life pen-friend, a retired teacher in Quy Nhơn she met through a newspaper column, while her husband pretends to read the paper and keeps asking 'rồi răng nữa?'

tracks.title: Đếm Mạ Bằng Tiếng Tây Ban Nha
tracks.subject: a Vietnamese rice engineer on a cooperation project in Los Palacios, Cuba, who counts seedlings wrong in Spanish all afternoon beside the Cuban agronomist Yanelis, teaches her to ask 'ăn cơm chưa', and files for an extension after three harvests

tracks.title: 唔該唔好掂
tracks.subject: a gallery attendant at the Hong Kong Museum of History who spends her whole shift telling visitors not to touch the red-sail fishing junk and the old tram, a schoolboy who climbs in and rings the tram bell, and her own secret tap on the junk's glass case after closing

tracks.title: 三點四十五
tracks.subject: a married couple who both work non-teaching jobs at the same secondary school, the lab technician and the librarian, meeting every day at 3:45 after the bell to split one cold bottle of Vitasoy in the empty science prep room, six years on

tracks.title: 七點半校門口
tracks.subject: a young woman whose older sister paid her HK$8,000 school fees and would not take an IOU; with no money to repay, she walks her six-year-old niece to school at 7:30 every weekday for a year, ticking each trip on a fridge calendar, and when she finally brings the HK$8,000 the sister pushes it back and says the school runs aren't finished

tracks.title: 邊個又郁咗
tracks.subject: a man who spends a Sunday putting the family's living-room TV channels in a sensible order, then wages a running war with his mum, little sister, grandpa and dad, who keep scrambling it, until a family vote puts the Korean drama channel first

tracks.title: 數錯湯圓
tracks.subject: an old man in Tsuen Wan who, every winter solstice eve, hand-rolls black-sesame tong yuen, two each, for his three grown children's households and grandkids coming for dinner, keeps miscounting, ends up three over, then needs four more when his son brings his girlfriend's mother and his son-in-law wants four, and gives his own bowl to his grandson

tracks.title: 臭花倒數
tracks.subject: Taipei botanical garden staff and a growing crowd waiting four nights for a giant corpse flower (titan arum) to open, everyone holding their noses and refusing to go home

tracks.title: 阿姨的手不要抖
tracks.subject: a high-school boy who tries every trick for a month (compliments, a birthday card, helping wipe trays) to stop the canteen auntie's ladle shaking the braised pork back into the pot

tracks.title: 原封不動
tracks.mood: giddy, sly, in on the joke
tracks.subject: an office secret-santa exchange on the last Friday before Christmas where, gift by gift, it emerges that everyone has quietly regifted last year's present, still in its wrapping

tracks.title: 雙人車 一個人騎
tracks.subject: a woman at a riverside bike-rental shop counter ending the annual tandem-bicycle rental her ex signed them both up for, while the owner keeps asking where the other rider is; she takes the tandem out alone for one last lap along the river before handing it back

tracks.title: 四個月見一次針頭
tracks.subject: a couple who first met in the next beds at a blood donation centre and have gone back together every four months for six years, he still scared of the needle and holding her hand, she squeezing the rubber ball for him

tracks.title: Send It to the Lab
tracks.mood: swaggering, sheepish and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a first-year hobby farmer in Ohio who mails a zip bag of his back-field dirt to the state university extension lab, brags to the feed store all month, and gets the report back saying it is mostly gravel and needs two tons of lime

tracks.title: Through the Studio Glass
